edits.text: When the user asks for a refund, also load the `airline:cancel` skill.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from using the `cancel_reservation` tool for partial refunds, which would cancel the entire reservation.

edits.text: Before calling book_reservation, check if the user already has a reservation that matches the requested origin, destination, and dates. If they do, update that reservation instead of booking a new one.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from creating duplicate reservations when a matching one already exists.

edits.text: When calculating the total cost for a reservation, multiply the sum of the prices of all flights in the itinerary by the number of passengers.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent correctly calculates the total cost per passenger for the booking tool.

edits.text: When the user specifies a sequence of changes (e.g., 'first... then...'), perform each change as a separate tool call in the order requested.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from merging sequential requests into a single tool call, ensuring intermediate states are preserved.
